description_en: Retrieves the details of a VPC firewall that protects traffic between two VPCs connected by an Express Connect circuit
description_zh: 查询VPC边界防火墙（防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的流量）的详细信息
name: DescribeVpcFirewallDetail

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342932.html operation to query the instance ID of the VPC firewall
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342932.html接口查询VPC边界防火墙的实例ID

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth of the Express Connect circuit. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 高速通道的带宽规格。单位：Mbps

ConnectType.description_en: The connection type of the VPC firewall. The value is fixed as expressconnect, which indicates Express Connect
ConnectType.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙的互通类型。取值：expressconnect，表示高速通道

FirewallSwitchStatus.description_en:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

opened: The firewall is enabled.

closed: The firewall is disabled.

notconfigured: The firewall is not configured.

configured: The firewall is configured
FirewallSwitchStatus.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的状态。取值：
opened：已开启。
closed：已关闭。
notconfigured：表示暂未配置VPC边界防火墙。
configured：表示已配置VPC边界防火墙
